concerns.text: The plan's own Dataset Strategy states CodeVulnBench and the human-written subset (Juliet) have 'NO verified source found'. The fail-loud ingest design is honest, but as written the plan cannot produce any real results — the core data resource is unresolved. The plan should propose at least one concrete, verifiable open dataset pair (e.g., a Hugging Face LLM-code corpus with a reachable URL plus a human-code corpus) so the spec amendment it requests has a candidate, rather than deferring the entire dataset selection to execution time where the run is designed to halt.

Task 1 says ingest 'attempts programmatic download of CodeVulnBench' but no manifest source is named anywhere in the plan or research.md. The manifest-driven design needs at least a placeholder manifest schema entry (source id, expected checksum reference) so the 'canonical source' required by Constitution Principle I is defined before implementation.
